candidate_scope: Explicit-retrieval video world models that preserve a stable source ID across every auditable conditioning branch.
candidate: Conditioned on the naturally selected and addressable source set, match exogenous controls and non-target initial state, coherently intervene on one runtime-selected source across every real consumer path, recompute every descendant of that source, separately test post-selection influence, pre-treatment geometry localization, and signed benefit relative to a fair replacement, then test held-out incremental prediction beyond retrieval and attention baselines.
research_questions: Which 2025-2026 works cover Store, Select, Address, Consume, Localize, and Benefit/Accept?
Does any checked primary paper or official code snapshot jointly implement a source-level exogenous-matched all-path descendant-recomputed geometry-localized natural-error-predictive protocol?
What cheapest falsifiable experiment distinguishes the candidate from attention visualization, module ablation, or a generic gate?

contract_revision.reason: WorldTrace demonstrates that a stored memory can become unreadable because its positional address is outside the training distribution, so selection and addressability must be tested separately.
contract_revision.claim_boundary: This is a refinement of the research question, not evidence that the candidate is novel or effective.

primary_sources.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
primary_sources.pressure: Makes Address an explicit independent stage and separates position addressability from content informativeness.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: No ordinary-run selected single-source exogenous-matched, descendant-recomputed all-consumer-path output-localization and natural-error-prediction protocol was identified.

primary_sources.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
primary_sources.pressure: Camera/action-correspondent chunk retrieval plus native attention consumption establishes strong Store, Select, Address, and system-benefit precedent.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: Attention correspondence and chunk/module ablations do not establish one selected source's all-path total effect or pre-treatment geometry-localized output effect.

primary_sources.title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
primary_sources.pressure: Relative-viewpoint encoding and attention-driven implicit retrieval occupy geometry-conditioned Select, Address, and Consume design space.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: No selected-item exact-replay all-path intervention or per-item causal prediction of natural revisit error was identified.

primary_sources.title: DensityKV: Density-Guided KV Cache Compression for Long Video Generation
primary_sources.pressure: Per-head token banks, post-RoPE key geometry, exact K/V retention, and admission traces establish token-level storage and retention diagnostics.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: Admission and retention do not establish a retained source's causal output effect or geometry-localized benefit.

primary_sources.title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
primary_sources.pressure: Camera-ray-queryable geometry supervision on compressed memory and patch-level VGGT distillation make geometry-aware memory supervision non-distinctive by itself.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: The memory explicitly lacks one-to-one source correspondence; no runtime single-source all-path counterfactual, output localization, or item-level natural-error prediction was identified.

primary_sources.title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
primary_sources.pressure: Patch provenance, target-view alignment, pre-treatment support, unified attention, and fixed-seed module ablation are strong component precedents.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: No ordinary-run selected single-item all-path total effect, area-baseline localization, or incremental prediction of natural failure was identified.

primary_sources.title: I3DM
primary_sources.pressure: Spatial confidence maps, maximum-coverage selection, 3D alignment, and reliable-region injection strongly overlap Select, Consume, and Localize.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: The remaining candidate difference is a runtime-selected source's coherent all-path post-selection effect, matched-mask enrichment, and held-out signed benefit.

primary_sources.title: TetherCache: Stabilizing Autoregressive Long-Form Video Generation with Gated Recall and Trusted Alignment
primary_sources.pressure: GRAB occupies attention-plus-diversity selection and TAME occupies trusted memory editing, so generic gate, admission, and repair are not candidate novelties.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: No stable-source all-path causal localization and incremental signed-benefit prediction beyond the selection and repair proxies was identified.

primary_sources.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
primary_sources.version_boundary: The checked commit includes a geometry path added after arXiv v1; it is not evidence that the v1 tables validated that path.
primary_sources.pressure: Matched storage/readout/recurrence comparisons and replay versus return already establish that stored memory and usable readout differ.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: No ordinary-run stable single-source post-selection all-path effect, pre-treatment geometry localization, and matched signed benefit was identified.

primary_sources.title: CUE-R: Beyond the Final Answer in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
primary_sources.authors: Siddharth Jain and Venkat Narayan Vedam
primary_sources.pressure: Actually used evidence selection, REMOVE/REPLACE/DUPLICATE, paired signed utility, bootstrap intervals, and multi-evidence synergy occupy the abstract per-item intervention-to-utility pattern.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: The remaining difference is the video-specific connection among stable visual source identity, multiple consumer paths, camera and pre-treatment geometry support, and natural revisit quality.

primary_sources.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
primary_sources.pressure: Defines visual evidence utility through output-distribution information gain and trains a lightweight surrogate, so output influence and a utility gate are not novel in the abstract.
primary_sources.joint_gap_not_identified_in_checked_mate: Influence must be separated from signed benefit, and a later acceptance head must show added value from geometry-localized causal labels.

official_code_keyword_probe.interpretation: This is bounded negative evidence for the named snapshots and vocabulary only. It is not proof of semantic absence or field-wide novelty.

prerequisites: A reproducible natural revisit failure in real C1 and confirmation C2 generation
An ordinary-run selected and currently addressable source
A low-intensity appearance-only source edit with fixed geometry and retrieval identity

factorial_cells.F00: Original source through all real consumer paths
factorial_cells.F10: Edit only the CLIP path; conflict diagnostic only
factorial_cells.F01: Edit only the replace/latent path; conflict diagnostic only
factorial_cells.F11: The same edit coherently enters every real consumer path

gates: The paired total-effect lower confidence bound exceeds exact-replay variation
The within-support effect fraction lower confidence bound exceeds the pre-treatment support area fraction
The geometry enrichment ratio exceeds one and the 95th percentile of masks matched on area, shape, edge density, and baseline error
Signed B_local and B_matched are stable across fair-placebo constructions and add held-out value beyond attention, pose/FoV, recency, retrieval score, source quality, support area, and simple gates
decisive_experiment.matched_mask_null: Permutation masks must be matched to the pre-treatment support on area, shape, edge density, and baseline error; random boxes alone are insufficient.

recompute: every attention and fusion state descended from the target source
causal_estimand_correction.reason: Freezing downstream mediators would block the target source's causal paths and would not estimate total effect.
causal_estimand_correction.scope_boundary: Because the ordinary selected set is fixed after observation, the estimand is a post-selection downstream effect conditional on that set, not a Store-to-Select total effect.

benefit_estimand_correction.influence: F11-F00 under a low-intensity geometry-preserving appearance edit measures nonnegative post-selection output sensitivity beyond exact replay.
benefit_estimand_correction.localization: The influence map is tested against a pre-treatment geometry support and matched-mask permutation null.
benefit_estimand_correction.why_not_benefit: A large output change can improve or worsen quality, so its magnitude or heatmap does not identify utility sign.
benefit_estimand_correction.B_local: Half the sum of losses under symmetric low-intensity positive and negative photometric alternatives, minus the original-source loss, with source ID, slot, address, token count, order, mask, pose, intrinsics, geometry support, context, and non-target state held fixed.
benefit_estimand_correction.B_matched: Loss under a preregistered unselected frame matched on scene, object identity, pose, FoV, and support, minus original-source loss; it estimates benefit only relative to that matched alternative.
benefit_estimand_correction.required_reference: Real ground-truth return or a frozen real revisit observation defined before treatment-output inspection.

kill_or_reposition_conditions: No stable natural real-generation failure is found
Exact-replay variation is comparable to the intervention effect
Addressability repair alone explains the failures
F11 fails while only path-incoherent F10 or F01 responds
Geometry localization does not exceed both the support-area baseline and the matched-mask 95th percentile
B_local or B_matched changes sign across fair placebo constructions or lacks an independent frozen reference
The influence, localization, and signed-benefit fields do not predict held-out natural error or benefit
Ordinary attention, pose/FoV, recency, retrieval score, source quality, support area, or a generic gate matches the risk-coverage result
The effect does not reproduce across scenes and consumers
A newly public primary work completes the same six-stage joint contract

independent_adversarial_audit.verdict: Weak Accept for one cheap falsification experiment; Reject as a novelty claim or method claim today.

allowed_claim: A narrowly architecture-scoped six-stage joint contract was not identified in the explicitly checked primary-source and official-code scope, so one strict low-cost falsification experiment remains justified.
forbidden_claims: the field has no equivalent method
PhD or CCF-A level has already been achieved
